# Populating your links {#sec-links}

*Due with HW2.*

Fill in each link in index.html:

- **GitHub:** `https://github.com/<username>`
- **CV:** upload your PDF to the `documents/` folder and link to it
- **LinkedIn:** your public profile URL
- **Kaggle:** `https://www.kaggle.com/<username>`
- **Blog:** `https://<username>.github.io/blog/` (see Chapter @sec-blog)
